findings.detail: 4 pods name it, in: shop (4). From 1.26 a pod that names it, or that mounts a claim bound to a PersistentVolume that does, does not start.
findings.remediation: migrate the volumes to another storage solution before the upgrade; there is no CSI migration for GlusterFS
findings.title: In-tree volume plugin glusterfs removed in 1.26 (4 pods)

findings.detail: 3 pods name it, in: shop (3). From 1.27 the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver serves every operation on these volumes: a cluster without it installed cannot mount them, one with it is fine.
findings.remediation: install the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver (aws-ebs-csi-driver) before the upgrade
findings.title: In-tree volume plugin awsElasticBlockStore needs CSI driver ebs.csi.aws.com from 1.27 (3 pods)

findings.detail: 2 pods name it, in: ci (1), kube-system (1). From 1.33 a pod that names it, or that mounts a claim bound to a PersistentVolume that does, does not start. Upstream: disabled by default in 1.33, where the GitRepoVolumeDriver feature gate can still turn it back on, and locked off in 1.36.
findings.remediation: clone the repository into an emptyDir volume from an init container, and mount that emptyDir
findings.title: In-tree volume plugin gitRepo removed in 1.33 (2 pods)
